title: C: Concurrency (Simulated)
description: Simulate a simple round-robin scheduler that switches between multiple tasks without using threads.

steps.title: Task Structure
steps.description: Define a `Task` struct with an id, state (READY/RUNNING/DONE), a function pointer to the task function, and its argument. Create 3 tasks that print their ID and a message.
hints: Use `typedef enum { READY, RUNNING, DONE } State;`.

verification.failureMessage: Run all 3 tasks in round-robin order
